WITH ccc_components AS (
  SELECT
    'DSO (Days Sales Outstanding)' AS component,
    SUM(pa.days_to_pay * pa.amount_applied) / SUM(pa.amount_applied) AS days

  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT

    (SELECT AVG(daily_value) FROM (
      SELECT snap.snapshot_date_key, SUM(snap.value_on_hand) AS daily_value
      FROM mro_distributor.inv_balance_snapshot snap

    WHEN component = 'DPO (Days Payable Outstanding)' THEN 'Supplier payment timing'
  END AS driver_type,
  ROUND(days, 1) || ' days' AS formatted
FROM ccc_components

    SUM(pa.days_to_pay * pa.amount_applied) / SUM(pa.amount_applied) AS dso_value
  FROM mro_distributor.ar_payment_application pa
  GROUP BY pa.subsidiary_key
),

      FROM mro_distributor.inv_balance_snapshot
      GROUP BY snapshot_date_key
    )) /

     FROM mro_distributor.o2c_sales_order_line sol) AS dio_value
  FROM mro_distributor.inv_balance_snapshot snap
  GROUP BY snap.subsidiary_key
),
dpo_by_subsidiary AS (
  SELECT 
    bp.subsidiary_key,
    SUM(bp.days_to_pay * bp.amount_paid) / SUM(bp.amount_paid) AS dpo_value
  FROM mro_distributor.p2p_bill_payment bp
  GROUP BY bp.subsidiary_key
)
SELECT 
  s.subsidiary_key,
  s.subsidiary_name,
  COALESCE(dso.dso_value, 0) AS dso_days,
  COALESCE(dio.dio_value, 0) AS dio_days,
  COALESCE(dpo.dpo_value, 0) AS dpo_days,
  COALESCE(dso.dso_value, 0) + COALESCE(dio.dio_value, 0) - COALESCE(dpo.dpo_value, 0) AS ccc_days,
  CASE 
    WHEN COALESCE(dso.dso_value, 0) >= COALESCE(dio.dio_value, 0) AND COALESCE(dso.dso_value, 0) >= COALESCE(dpo.dpo_value, 0) THEN 'DSO'

LEFT JOIN dio_by_subsidiary dio ON s.subsidiary_key = dio.subsidiary_key
